stages.blurb: Chat stays connected (a live socket), not a new page load for every bubble.
Who you are, who is online, and the message router are three separate pieces.
Photos and voice notes are their own path. Unread badges live in a fast cache.
Chat history, group members, and file attachments are three stores.
If the other phone is asleep, a queue plus a push notification delivers later.
Device keys (if chats are encrypted) and a CDN for stickers finish this map.
